text:
Our review of “3 embedded Folder” found 1 likely cause of the problems in Frontify and 1 possible contributing factor. The recommended changes are below.

Likely causes

1. Embedded image
Frontify needs images as separate linked files and can’t read images embedded in the document.
Where: images “Screen2_women_cmyk_300dpi.jpg” (page 1), “phone_journey-start-switzerland_campaign_de.svg” (page 1) and “X.ai” (page 1)
• In Window > Links, select the image and choose Unembed Link from the panel menu.
• Save it into the Links folder and package again.
Learn more

Possible contributing factors

2. Document has bleed
Bleed is added to every export, which is right for print templates but usually unwanted for digital ones.
Current bleed: 5 mm on all sides
• For a digital template, set bleed to 0 in File > Document Setup > Bleed and Slug. For print templates, bleed is fine.
Learn more

Once that’s done, package the document again with File > Package, zip the package folder and upload it to Frontify.
